title: Text: DET Doug Teter ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Talked to Miguel this afternoon, mentioned the bicep takes 1 1/2 years to fully recover. How do I write that, like he’s cool to play but not fully recovered yet?
Hey I’m not going to say anything concerning the comments of one of our players.  He’s free to say whatever he feels but I can’t comment.  Sorry bud
Ok. I mean, I’m not quoting you, I’m just trying to avoid the “why is Cabrera playing if he’s not fully recovered”

Anthony I’m not trying to be difficult but I really don’t know how to write this one.  The way you worded it in the first text would probably be the best I suppose.  I would love to tell you what I think but just can’t.
I know you’re not. No worries. Just wanted to reach out
